wallet.title: Wallet address
wallet.description: EVM wallet to audit (0x...). Chain data only — no keys required, no funds moved.

chains.title: Chain ids
chains.description: Only Ethereum mainnet (1) is supported in this version.

mode.title: Data source mode
mode.description: logs = no API key needed (recommended). etherscan = full history (requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY env).

stale_after_days.title: Stale threshold (days)
stale_after_days.description: Approvals older than this are flagged as stale.

lookback_blocks.title: Approval event lookback (blocks)
lookback_blocks.description: How far back to scan Approval events. Known-spender allowances are always checked exactly.

top_tokens.title: Number of top tokens to scan
top_tokens.description: How many of the canonical top ERC-20 tokens to scan for Approval events.
